name: 5x Fight Speed
displayDescription: Watch your robot fight at 5x speed! Bot fights play out much faster, so you clear rounds and earn money in less time. Switch between 1x, 2x and 5x anytime during a fight. One-time purchase – yours forever.

name: 2x Faster Training
displayDescription: All your robots train 2x faster at the punching bag – they punch twice as fast. Works for every robot you own. One-time purchase – yours forever.

name: Instant Spin
displayDescription: No more waiting at your Spin Pillar! Pull the lever and your next part appears instantly – the spin animation is skipped. One-time purchase – yours forever.

name: Big Scrap Bag
displayDescription: Carry 50 scrap instead of 10! Collect five times more scrap before you have to walk back to your shredder - more scrap per trip means more money. One-time purchase - yours forever.

name: Scrap Magnet
displayDescription: Scrap flies to you! Every piece of scrap within 20 studs around you is collected automatically - no need to pick it up. Fill your pocket faster and shred more scrap for money. One-time purchase - yours forever.

name: Samurai Mech (Limited)
displayDescription:
⚔️ LIMITED – only 100 will ever exist! ⚔️

Get the Samurai Mech, a complete Epic robot (head, upper body and lower body) straight into your inventory – no scrap searching needed!

• Special Ability: Sword Slash – cuts through bot armor
• Epic stats: tons of health and heavy hits right from level 1
• x3.6 Level Multi – gets stronger with every level you train
• Exclusive samurai armor with glowing pink neon

Once all 100 are sold, it's gone forever. Claim yours before it's too late!

name: 10 Robot Slots
displayDescription: Build a bigger robot army! Raises your robot storage from 3 to 10 robots. Keep more of your favorite fighters, collect every rarity and switch between them anytime. One-time purchase – yours forever!
